questions.question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The committee insisted that every proposal is reviewed (1)/ before it was placed (2)/ before the board (3)/ for final approval. (4)/
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence lies in the phrase "that every proposal is reviewed."
 
• The word "is" should be replaced with "be" to indicate the subjunctive mood, which is used to express suggestions, demands, or hypothetical situations.
 
• The revised phrase should be "that every proposal **be** reviewed" to maintain grammatical accuracy.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The committee insisted that every proposal **be** reviewed before it was placed before the board for final approval."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 2: "before it was placed"** – This part is correct as it uses the past tense appropriately.
 
• **Part 3: "before the board"** – This part is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "for final approval"** – This part is correct and does not require any changes.

questions.question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The crowd cheered the athlete loudly.

options.text: The athlete was cheered loudly by the crowd.
The athlete is cheered loudly by the crowd.
The athlete had been cheering loudly.
Loud cheering was done by the athlete.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The crowd cheered the athlete loudly."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the athlete" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "cheered" to "was cheered" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the crowd."
 
• Ensure the adverb "loudly" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The athlete was cheered loudly by the crowd."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The athlete is cheered loudly by the crowd." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The athlete had been cheering loudly." – Incorrect sentence structure (active voice, past perfect tense).
 
• **Option 4: **"Loud cheering was done by the athlete." – Incorrect subject and meaning.
</ul

questions.question:
Select the correct option for the Direct Speech conversion:

She warned that if the quorum was not achieved, the resolution would expire.

options.text: She said, “If the quorum is not achieved, the resolution will expire.”
She said, “If quorum was not achieved, resolution expired.”
She said, “Unless quorum had been achieved, resolution would expire.”
She said, “The resolution expired without quorum.”

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She warned that if the quorum was not achieved, the resolution would expire.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if the quorum was not achieved" becomes "if the quorum is not achieved"**
 
 
• The past tense "was" is converted to present tense "is" to match direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"the resolution would expire" becomes "the resolution will expire"**
 
 
• The modal verb "would" is replaced by "will" to align with the direct speech format.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "warned that"
 
• Converted to: "said" in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "If" and ends with a period "."
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said, ‘If the quorum is not achieved, the resolution will expire.’"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "She said, ‘If quorum was not achieved, resolution expired.’" 
 
 
• Incorrect tense usage: "was not achieved" and "expired" are in the past tense, which does not align with the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She said, ‘Unless quorum had been achieved, resolution would expire.’" 
 
 
• Incorrect conjunction "unless" and past perfect tense "had been achieved" distort the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said, ‘The resolution expired without quorum.’" 
 
 
• Changes the meaning completely, implying that the resolution already expired.
